facts.label: Instruir e comparar
facts.sub: Use o verbo no início para instruções: Mix the colors. Use -er than ou more + adjetivo para comparar: My brush is bigger than yours.

facts.label: Instruções
facts.sub: Para dar uma instrução, comece com o verbo: Mix the colors. Use a small brush. Add some white. Adicione please para ser mais gentil.

facts.label: Comparativos
facts.sub: Adjetivos curtos usam -er + than: bigger than, darker than, easier than. Adjetivos longos usam more: more beautiful than. Good vira better.

pages.title: An art room · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Wednesday evening in an art room in Houston. Tubes of paint lie on a long table. Clara stands near a big canvas. Her friend Henry sits next to her with a brush. His picture is still almost white. Clara looks at it and smiles.
“Clara, your painting is nice! Your colors are better than mine.” says Henry. “Thanks! Use more blue. It looks nicer in the sky.” says Clara. “Like this? Is it darker now?” says Henry.
